ex.en: Workers erected a temporary stage in the square.
ex.zh: 工人们在广场上搭起了一个临时舞台。

words.note: erect 作动词指建造、竖起，比 build 正式。

ex.en: You should seek professional advice before signing the contract.
ex.zh: 签合同前你应该听取专业建议。

words.note: professional 指职业的、专业的；名词是 profession。

ex.en: The home team won the match three nil.
ex.zh: 主队以三比零赢得了比赛。

words.note: nil 多用于比分或统计，表示“零”，英式英语常见。

ex.en: Please bring photo identification when you come to the interview.
ex.zh: 面试时请带上带照片的证件。

words.note: identification 常缩略为 ID，指身份证明。

ex.en: Many migrant workers send money home to their families.
ex.zh: 许多外来务工者把钱寄回家。

words.note: migrant 指流动的人或动物；immigrant 指移入者。

ex.en: Beans and nuts are a good source of protein.
ex.zh: 豆类和坚果是很好的蛋白质来源。

words.note: protein 指蛋白质，常说 source of protein。

ex.en: The company holds its annual meeting in the spring.
ex.zh: 公司在春季举行年度会议。

words.note: annual 指每年的；副词 annually，名词 anniversary 同源。

ex.en: The magazine published an exclusive interview with the singer.
ex.zh: 这家杂志刊登了对那位歌手的独家采访。

words.note: exclusive 指独家的、排他的；exclusive of 表不包括。

ex.en: The pianist has a wide repertoire of classical pieces.
ex.zh: 这位钢琴家有大量古典曲目。

words.note: repertoire 指演员或音乐家的全部曲目，也指技能储备。

ex.en: Millions of families still live in poverty in that region.
ex.zh: 那个地区仍有数百万家庭生活贫困。

words.note: poverty 不可数；live in poverty 表生活贫困。

ex.en: The two sides should not resort to force to settle disputes.
ex.zh: 双方不应诉诸武力来解决争端。

words.note: resort to 后接名词或动名词，表不得已而采用。

ex.en: Two witnesses agreed to testify against the driver in court.
ex.zh: 两名证人同意在法庭上指证那名司机。

words.note: testify 后接 against sb 指控，to sth 证明。

ex.en: She wore a simple pearl necklace to the wedding.
ex.zh: 她戴着一条朴素的珍珠项链参加婚礼。

words.note: pearl 指珍珠，pearl necklace 是最常见搭配。

ex.en: The police have not yet found conclusive evidence against him.
ex.zh: 警方尚未找到针对他的确凿证据。

words.note: conclusive 指能最终定论的，常修饰 evidence、proof。

ex.en: The team won the game by a narrow margin of two points.
ex.zh: 该队以两分的微弱优势赢得了比赛。

words.note: margin 指差额、余地；by a narrow margin 表以微弱优势。

ex.en: Children are apt to imitate what they see on screen.
ex.zh: 孩子容易模仿他们在屏幕上看到的东西。

words.note: be apt to do 表易于做某事；apt 也指恰当贴切。

ex.en: The weather remained cold for the rest of the week.
ex.zh: 那周余下时间天气一直很冷。

words.note: remain 是系动词，后接形容词；名词常用复数 remains。

ex.en: She stopped working during her second pregnancy last year.
ex.zh: 去年她第二次怀孕期间停止了工作。

words.note: pregnancy 为名词，形容词形式是 pregnant。

ex.en: He wore a shabby coat that had seen better days.
ex.zh: 他穿着一件早已破旧的外套。

words.note: shabby 指衣物破旧，也指行为卑鄙不公。

ex.en: They tossed a coin to decide who would go first.
ex.zh: 他们抛硬币决定谁先去。

words.note: toss a coin 指掷币决定；toss and turn 指辗转难眠。

ex.en: The factory cannot meet the demand for its new phones.
ex.zh: 这家工厂无法满足对新手机的需求。

words.note: demand 后接 that 从句时常用虚拟语气 (should) do。

ex.en: The town is still reeling from the earthquake.
ex.zh: 这个小镇仍因地震而惊魂未定。

words.note: reel from 指因打击而踉跄；a reel of film 指一卷胶片。

ex.en: He gave a pathetic excuse for missing the deadline.
ex.zh: 他为错过截止日期找了个蹩脚的借口。

words.note: pathetic 指可怜，也常指差劲、令人失望。

ex.en: The morning fog dissipated as the sun rose higher.
ex.zh: 太阳升起，晨雾渐渐消散。

words.note: dissipate 指雾气消散，也指精力、钱财被挥霍。

ex.en: The chemist heated the liquid in a small glass flask.
ex.zh: 化学家在小型玻璃烧瓶里加热液体。

words.note: flask 指实验室烧瓶，也可指随身小酒瓶。

ex.en: The manager accused him of leaking the plan to the press.
ex.zh: 经理指责他把计划泄露给了媒体。

words.note: accuse sb of sth 用 of，不能用 for；名词 accusation。

ex.en: The noisy neighbors caused a serious disturbance last night.
ex.zh: 吵闹的邻居昨晚引起了严重骚乱。

words.note: disturbance 指骚乱或打扰；动词是 disturb。

ex.en: Many readers had a visceral reaction to the shocking news.
ex.zh: 许多读者对这则惊人消息有本能反应。

words.note: visceral 源自“内脏”，引申为发自本能、不加思考的。

ex.en: The conference offered simultaneous interpretation in three languages.
ex.zh: 会议提供三种语言的同声传译。

words.note: simultaneous 常修饰 interpretation 这类活动。

ex.en: The school has produced new instructional videos for online classes.
ex.zh: 学校为网课制作了新的教学视频。

words.note: instructional 修饰材料、视频、设计，指教学用途的。
